profile.name: BestDeep
profile.headline: AI & Blockchain Engineer · Full-Stack Developer
profile.intro: I build at the intersection of machine learning and decentralized networks. Most of my recent work is on Bittensor subnets: miners, validators, and the agents, models and data pipelines behind them, plus the full-stack pieces around them: APIs, dashboards, bots and dApps.

projects.title: Autonomous multi-agent ML engineering loop
projects.summary: A team of autonomous Claude Code agents running endless headless sessions across several machines and coordinating only through git. Planner, builder, reviewer, explorer and janitor roles; git task locks; a gated landing flow with a sealed holdout and a bit-exact replica of the validator's scorer; content-addressed cached evaluation; and a supervisor dashboard for machines, jobs and the live scoreboard.

projects.title: Cricket delivery ball-tracking (Bittensor SN44)
projects.summary: Broadcast cricket clip in; bounce point, stump crossing, swing, deviation, speed, release and impact out. GPU perception feeds cached observations into pure-CPU geometry and a learned residual corrector. Includes a standalone multi-miner axon that routes requests by hotkey and races primary and fallback GPU backends against the deadline.

projects.title: vidaio-subnet
projects.summary: Vidaio subnet (SN85): decentralized AI video upscaling and compression, with miners and validators scored on perceptual quality.

projects.title: Football action spotting (Bittensor SN44)
projects.summary: 30-second broadcast clip in, timestamped events over 15 weighted action classes out. T-DEED-style spotter with Gate-Shift-Fuse and an SGP temporal encoder initialized from a SoccerNet-Ball checkpoint, optical-flow camera-motion features, overlapping-window inference with displacement voting, and per-class thresholds tuned on an exact replica of the validator score.

projects.title: Large-scale model distillation
projects.summary: Competitive model distillation on a Bittensor subnet: compressing a 1T-parameter MoE teacher into students of at most 33B, scored on a 25+ axis composite covering math, code, reasoning, long context and honesty.

projects.title: Bittensor monitoring bot
projects.summary: Telegram bot for real-time Bittensor monitoring: subnet parameter changes, registrations and costs, unstaking, stake thresholds and wallet activity, plus miner and validator registration from chat.

projects.title: liveweb_arena
projects.summary: Real-time evaluation framework for LLM browser agents on live websites (CoinGecko, Taostats, Stooq, weather), plus SFT dataset generation aligned with the benchmark.

projects.title: swe_agent
projects.summary: GitHub-native patch agent: reads an issue or /patch comment, locates relevant files, generates edits with an LLM, commits a valid patch on a branch and opens a PR with CI checks.

projects.title: LLM-judge data pipeline
projects.summary: End-to-end data pipeline: vLLM generation of king and challenger replies, LLM-judge scoring, and SFT/DPO/GRPO/RFT dataset building on a MySQL-backed store with read-only-by-default tooling.

projects.title: Agent evaluation framework
projects.summary: Evaluation and training framework for AgentGym-style benchmarks: logic-reasoning dataset generation, QLoRA/SFT/MoE-routing training, prompt policies for game environments, and SWE, live-web and game environments.

projects.title: LLM fine-tune & OpenAI-compatible serving
projects.summary: Fetches and cleans agent conversation data into ShareGPT format, fine-tunes with LLaMA-Factory, and serves the result behind an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API.

projects.title: MoE fine-tuning toolkit
projects.summary: Fine-tuning toolkit for DeepSeek-V3-architecture MoE models (Moonlight-16B-A3B): LoRA/QLoRA, full SFT, DPO with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, and forward-KL distillation from a local or logprob-cached teacher, served with SGLang.

projects.title: natix_classifer
projects.summary: Image classifier training for the Natix network: multi-backbone runs (ConvNeXt, EfficientNet, ViT, Swin) over real and synthetic roadwork data.

projects.title: Token presale dApp
projects.summary: Token presale dApp: React + Vite + Tailwind frontend with its smart contract.

projects.title: mantis_miner
projects.summary: Miner for MANTIS (SN123): embeddings that help predict one-hour moves of financial instruments.

projects.title: Offline reward replica & RL training
projects.summary: Offline replica of a subnet's three-judge evaluation reward, used to answer "would this model win?" before spending an on-chain upload, with SFT, DPO, self-play and online/offline GRPO trainers.

projects.title: agents_collection
projects.summary: LLM-driven and hand-written agents for AgentGym environments (SciWorld, TextCraft and more) on OpenAI-compatible APIs.

projects.title: bitsec_subnet
projects.summary: BitSec: AI-powered vulnerability detection for subnet codebases and smart contracts, with backend.

projects.title: Time-series generator tooling
projects.summary: Measurement and cost-aware A/B sweep suite for time-series generator development on a Bittensor subnet, built on the subnet's real evaluation pool, plus the resulting model variants.

projects.title: ML data & deployment utilities
projects.summary: Small services around the training loop: a Hugging Face dataset watcher that pulls, unpacks and triggers training on new revisions; a FastAPI patch server for SWE-bench Pro; an upload/download bucket server; and deployment scripts for serving large models on Chutes.

projects.title: llm_agent_bitquant
projects.summary: Crypto-analysis LLM agent API that classifies queries into six categories (portfolio, yield farming, trading and more) and routes each to specialized tools.

projects.title: miid
projects.summary: Backend for MIID (SN54), the identity-testing subnet.

projects.title: east_world
projects.summary: Eastworld (SN94): gyms for evaluating and training embodied, generally capable AI agents in an open virtual world.

projects.title: mini_swe_agent_rl
projects.summary: Extension of mini-swe-agent, the 100-line SWE agent, for reinforcement learning from human and dataset trajectories.

projects.title: compress
projects.summary: Video compression toolkit: encoder wrapper, VMAF quality scoring, scene classification and a learned image-quality model.

projects.title: Token-efficient reasoning trainer
projects.summary: GRPO LoRA training whose reward calls the validator's own scoring function, rewarding correct answers that use fewer tokens than the base model across math, multiple-choice and long-context evidence-selection benchmarks.

projects.title: kinitro-agent
projects.summary: Multi-task RL agent template for the Kinitro embodied-AI subnet: offline TD3+BC and online RL on MetaWorld MT50.

projects.title: 72B inference optimization
projects.summary: Optimized Qwen2.5-72B serving image for a Bittensor inference subnet on 4×H200, tuned for time-to-first-token and throughput under a strict logprob-correctness gate, with a local copy of the validator for scoring.

projects.title: DefiLlama-Adapters
projects.summary: DeFiLlama TVL adapter for the HyperLoan protocol.

projects.title: Connito-AI
projects.summary: Subnet 102: collaborative, decentralized training of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs with expert groups spread across miners.

projects.title: checkerchain_endpoint
projects.summary: Scoring endpoint service for the CheckerChain subnet.

projects.title: affine-dashboard
projects.summary: React + Node/Express dashboard for Affine (SN120) mining: sortable and filterable miner tables, auto-refresh and personal hotkey tracking.

projects.title: Fast on-chain registration CLI
projects.summary: Rust CLI for Bittensor subnet registration that fans out across several RPC endpoints, submits on new block heads and raises the tip over replace-by-fee rounds.

projects.title: bsty_extension
projects.summary: Open-source browser-extension wallet for Bitcoin NFTs.
